services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: TJJC’s after school program offers exclusive Jiu-Jitsu classes to kids in the program every school day. Students also have access to our regular programs, and a workspace for homework, snacks, and play time. They have plenty of fun in the program, but they build significant skills that develop discipline, confidence, and consistency which help set them up for adulthood. You might be wondering: "How is this different from a regular After School Program?" To learn more about the program, to see our various pricing options and inquire about whether or not it's right for your child, please reach out to us via email at info@torontojiujitsuclub.ca and let us know how we can help you!
